# Cascade App Agent Guidelines

- Validate environment configuration at service startup.
- Keep unit tests deterministic without real network I/O.

# Legacy Windsurf Workspace Rules

- Keep public HTTP handler modules free of direct ORM imports.

- Add concurrent indexes for tables exceeding one million rows.
- Document rollback steps in every migration header comment.

- Capture timeline timestamps in UTC ISO-8601 format.
